canonicalization.comparisonRule: Compare presence first, then compare only comparison.assertedFields using exact JSON scalar/array/object equality.
canonicalization.objectOrder: objects sorted by id using ordinal Unicode string order; coverage rows sorted by remote version or baseline filename; objectIds sorted by object id.

arrays.apiExecuteGrantees: PUBLIC, anon, authenticated, service_role; absent roles omitted
arrays.apiPrivileges: object keys PUBLIC, anon, authenticated, service_role; privileges ordered DELETE, INSERT, MAINTAIN, REFERENCES, SELECT, TRIGGER, TRUNCATE, UPDATE
arrays.policyRoles: PUBLIC, anon, authenticated, service_role, then lexicographic fallback

hashes.bodySha256: SHA-256 of the local dollar-quoted body or pg_proc.prosrc after CRLF/CR to LF, trailing horizontal whitespace removal, and outer whitespace trim.
hashes.expressionSha256: SHA-256 after CRLF/CR to LF and outer whitespace trim only. Internal whitespace, case, schema qualification, casts, operator grouping, parentheses, and literal text are preserved exactly.
hashes.defaultSha256: SHA-256 of the exact local DEFAULT payload or exact pg_catalog default expression after CRLF/CR to LF and outer whitespace trim only; null means no default. Internal whitespace, case, casts, parentheses, and literal text are preserved exactly.
hashes.commentSha256: SHA-256 after LF normalization, trailing horizontal whitespace removal, and outer trim; null means no comment.
hashes.definitionSha256: SHA-256 of the exact authored local constraint clause or exact pg_get_constraintdef text after CRLF/CR to LF and outer whitespace trim only. No case, qualification, cast, parenthesis, literal, or whitespace rewriting is performed.

canonicalization.grants: Effective ACLs are exploded. Function comparison includes only EXECUTE for API roles. Relation comparison uses the exact per-role privilege object; owner privileges are excluded. For REVOKE-only baselines, unmentioned privileges are preserved from the observed capture and the explicit local deltas are applied to form expected.

expressionCapture.indexKey: The structural outer key-list parentheses are located with a quote/comment/dollar-quote-aware balanced scanner; only the exact payload inside those delimiters is hashed.
expressionCapture.indexPredicate: The exact text after the top-level WHERE keyword is hashed.
expressionCapture.policyUsing: The structural USING parentheses are located with a quote/comment/dollar-quote-aware balanced scanner; only the exact payload inside those delimiters is hashed.
expressionCapture.policyCheck: The structural WITH CHECK parentheses are located with a quote/comment/dollar-quote-aware balanced scanner; only the exact payload inside those delimiters is hashed.
